items.title: Burrill Crohn interviewed by Monk Rowe, Woodstock, New York, January 3, 2012
items.q: And right here we have Joel Katz who made the film about the lyrics to “Strange Fruit.”

ctx.x: Yes, Monk, friend and colleague. I feel one of the great benefits of the Joe Williams film was we got to meet, and that’s another blessing, and will continue to be. And go get Don McGlynn and get — who else should you get — I’ll tell you. There are other people
making films about jazz. And right here we have Joel Katz who made the film about the lyrics to “Strange Fruit.”
He did that film? It was on PBS?
